enonce_markdown: A monitor has a resolution of 1920 x 1080. How many pixels does the screen contain in total?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

The total number of pixels is the number of columns multiplied by the number of rows.

### Solution

1920 x 1080 = **2 073 600 pixels** (about 2 megapixels). Adding the two numbers (3 000) or misplacing a digit gives the other values.

enonce_markdown: A shop prints invoices on multi-part stationery so that the customer, the accounts office and the shop each keep a copy from one printing. Which type of printer must it use?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Only an impact printer presses through the paper, so only it can mark several layers at once.

### Solution

A **dot-matrix printer** strikes an inked ribbon with pins and the force passes through to the copies below. Laser and inkjet printers are non-impact printers and only mark the top sheet.

enonce_markdown: A laser toner cartridge costs 45 000 FCFA and prints 3 000 pages. An inkjet cartridge costs 12 000 FCFA and prints 400 pages. How much MORE does the inkjet printer cost in cartridges to print 6 000 pages?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Number of cartridges = pages / yield; cost = cartridges x price; then subtract.

### Solution

Laser: 6 000 / 3 000 = 2 cartridges, 2 x 45 000 = 90 000 FCFA. Inkjet: 6 000 / 400 = 15 cartridges, 15 x 12 000 = 180 000 FCFA. Difference = 180 000 - 90 000 = **90 000 FCFA**. 180 000 is the inkjet cost alone, 33 000 is the difference in cartridge price, and 15 000 is the difference per 1 000 pages.

enonce_markdown: A printer works at 15 pages per minute. A teacher prints 5 copies of a 36-page document. How long does the job take, if the printer never stops?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Total pages = copies x pages per copy; time = total pages / speed.

### Solution

Total pages = 5 x 36 = 180. Time = 180 / 15 = **12 minutes**. 2.4 minutes is the time for one copy only, 9.6 minutes comes from counting four copies, and 108 minutes comes from multiplying by the speed instead of dividing.

enonce_markdown: Name the most suitable output device for EACH situation and justify your choice: (a) an architect must print building plans of size A0; (b) a supermarket till must print a customer receipt quickly and cheaply; (c) a visually impaired student wants to read the text of a document.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Choose the device from the output needed: size, speed, running cost and the user's ability.

### Solution

(a) **Plotter** (or wide-format printer): it draws large, precise line drawings on paper far wider than A3. (b) **Thermal printer**: it heats special paper, needs no ink or toner, is fast and quiet and cheap per receipt. (c) **Speech synthesiser with speakers or headphones** (or a **braille display/embosser**): it converts text into sound or touch, so the content can be accessed without sight.

enonce_markdown:
A school office prints about 3 000 black-and-white pages per month. It compares two printers over one year.

- Laser printer: price 180 000 FCFA; a toner cartridge costs 40 000 FCFA and prints 4 000 pages.
- Inkjet printer: price 60 000 FCFA; a cartridge costs 9 000 FCFA and prints 300 pages.

(a) Calculate the total cost of each printer over 12 months (purchase plus cartridges).

(b) Recommend a printer and give TWO other factors, apart from cost, that support your decision.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Total cost of ownership = purchase price + running cost; running cost = number of cartridges x cartridge price.

### Solution

**(a)** Pages in a year = 3 000 x 12 = 36 000.

- Laser: 36 000 / 4 000 = 9 cartridges, 9 x 40 000 = 360 000 FCFA; total = 180 000 + 360 000 = **540 000 FCFA**.
- Inkjet: 36 000 / 300 = 120 cartridges, 120 x 9 000 = 1 080 000 FCFA; total = 60 000 + 1 080 000 = **1 140 000 FCFA**.

**(b)** Recommend the **laser printer**: it costs 600 000 FCFA less over the year even though it is dearer to buy. Other factors: it prints faster (a large volume is printed every month), and it gives sharp text with toner that does not smudge, whereas inkjet cartridges need frequent replacement and the nozzles can block when the printer is not used often.
